title: 🎧Ep 184 What Wine Country Makes Possible – Corey Jordan of AMSTRDM & LIBRETTO
summary: 🍇 Where Wine Takes You, Episode Highlights 🍷 It’s harvest in Paso Robles, which means winemakers are moving fast, sleep is negotiable, and sitting still is not exactly the seasonal specialty. So this week, Adam follows the ripple effect of wine country in a different direction with Corey Jordan, Paso Robles native, musician, entrepreneur, and co-founder with his wife, Kate Jordan, of a growing collection of businesses helping shape what happens around the wine. Corey and Adam get into AMSTRDM Coffee House, Paso Robles Coffee Co., LIBRETTO, the LIBRETTO Conservatory, and the Paso Robles Jazz Fest, along with the larger idea connecting them all: Paso’s wine industry created an audience, a hospitality culture, and an expectation for quality that opened the door for entirely new kinds of businesses. Corey talks about growing up in Paso, leaving and coming home, opening AMSTRDM during the pandemic, roasting coffee with the same obsessive attention people bring to wine, collecting Steinways, building a serious listening room, and figuring out how to grow without sanding off what made something special in the first place. There’s also some breaking news in the conversation. Corey reveals plans for an AMSTRDM drive-through in San Miguel and another AMSTRDM location headed for downtown Los Angeles. Somehow the conversation also finds its way into old Paso tunnels, local history, jazz, coffee cupping, the Paderewski connection, and why sitting down at a piano is still Corey’s true north. 🌴 TRAVEL PASO SPOTLIGHT: THREE SPECKLED HENS For this week’s Travel Paso Spotlight, Adam goes treasure hunting with Three Speckled Hens Vintage Market & Antique Show, returning to the Paso Robles Event Center October 2 and 3. More than 75 vendors are expected with antiques, vintage furniture, clothing, jewelry, garden pieces, collectibles, food, drinks, and the wonderfully named Hen Pecked Husband area. A portion of every show’s proceeds benefits Jack’s Helping Hand. And there’s a little extra harvest-season nugget this week. Adam checks in by phone with Chris Eberle, winemaker at Eberle Winery, about his experience putting STRAUSS gear to work during harvest. STRAUSS is the official workwear partner of Paso Robles Wine Country. 🍷 GUEST + TRAVEL PASO LINKS Corey Jordan Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coreyjordannn/ @coreyjordannn AMSTRDM Coffee House Website: https://www.amstrdmpaso.com/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_amstrdm/ @_amstrdm Paso Robles Coffee Co. Website: https://www.pasoroblescoffeeco.com/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pasoroblescoffeeco/ @pasoroblescoffeeco LIBRETTO Website: https://www.librettopaso.com/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/librettopaso/ @librettopaso LIBRETTO Conservatory https://www.librettopaso.com/conservatory Paso Robles Jazz Fest Website: https://www.pasoroblesjazzfest.com/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pasoroblesjazzfestival/ @pasoroblesjazzfestival Three Speckled Hens Vintage Market & Antique Show Website: https://www.threespeckledhens.com/ 2026 Show Info: https://www.threespeckledhens.com/show-info Tickets: https://www.my805tix.com/e/threespeckled2026fall Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/threespeckledhens/ @threespeckledhens Travel Paso https://www.travelpaso.com 🌐 PASO WINE WIRE PASO ROBLES WINE COUNTRY VIRTUAL AUCTION The sixth annual Paso Robles Wine Country Virtual Auction runs through September 23 at 5 p.m. Pacific, with more than 40 curated packages featuring rare and allocated wines, private experiences, dining, lodging and wine-country getaways. Proceeds benefit the Paso Robles Wine Country Alliance Foundation, which has awarded 67 scholarships totaling $148,000 over the last five years. https://pasowine.com/events/virtual-auction/ HAWKS HILL RANCH EARNS NATIONAL TOUR HONOR Hawks Hill Ranch finished No. 2 nationally in The Zoe Report’s 2026 Readers’ Choice poll for Best U.S. Winery Tour, making it the highest-ranked Central Coast winery tour in the poll. https://pasoroblesdailynews.com/local-winery-ranks-no-2-in-national-tour-poll/223776/ TROUBLEMAKER NOW COMES IN A BOX Hope Family Wines has introduced 1.5-liter wine-in-box versions of Troublemaker Red and Troublemaker White, extending one of Paso’s most recognizable brands into a format built for pools, tailgates, weekends and places where glass bottles are not exactly invited. https://www.winebusiness.com/news/article/322998 🧰 STRAUSS HARVEST CHECK-IN Chris Eberle, Eberle Winery Adam catches up with Chris during harvest to hear how STRAUSS workwear performs when it actually has to deal with cellar floors, vineyards, long days and the messier side of making wine.
